description: Solo astrophysics and space science enthusiast tackling the 'Planet X and SPHEREx' challenge. Combining strong expertise in astronomy, celestial mechanics, and orbital calculations to design an intuitive method for spotting moving and variable objects across SPHEREx's 6-month all-sky infrared surveys.
summary: I developed a website which visualizes the difference and movement of the orbital bodies. It's based on the Nasa information provided by SPHEREx.
